name: PLA informatized/intelligentized joint operations (2026)

weightNotes.aggression: Strategic 'active defence' but operationally offensive: Science of Military Strategy (2013) and the DoD 2024 report describe seizing the initiative early with massed long-range joint fires (JOINT SWORD 2023 rehearsed this). Tempered because the political leadership has preferred coercion short of war since 1979.
weightNotes.maneuver: Systems destruction warfare (RAND RR-1708; DoD 2024: 'principal theory guiding its way of war') aims to paralyse the enemy's operational system by striking nodes rather than annihilating forces, which is manoeuvrist in intent; held near the middle because ground manoeuvre at scale is untested since 1979.
weightNotes.flanking: Doctrine favours striking key vulnerabilities across domains (Multi-Domain Precision Warfare) rather than frontal battle, but there is no recent evidence of operational-level envelopment; middling, educated judgement.
weightNotes.siegePreference: The defining contingency (Taiwan) ends in seizing ports, airfields and cities; DoD 2024 notes the PLA has 'not yet demonstrated' the urban warfare it would need. Raised above Western profiles for that objective set.
weightNotes.reserveUse: Echeloned joint campaign phases (firepower strike, blockade, landing) imply follow-on forces and a large strategic reserve inland; 0.35 is an educated guess.
weightNotes.scouting: Large reconnaissance satellite constellation, over-the-horizon radar, drones and the space/cyber/EW force created in 2015 (RAND RR-2058 on the Strategic Support Force) built to find and target US forces at range; below US because the kill chain beyond the first island chain is unproven.
weightNotes.retreatThreshold: No combat since 1979 (Sino-Vietnamese War, where the PLA accepted heavy losses: Zhang, Deng Xiaoping's Long War); political-work system aims at high cohesion. Educated guess, kept below modern breakpoints.
weightNotes.combinedArms: 2015-17 reforms created combined arms brigades and theatre joint commands, and the 2020 Joint Operations Outline (Trial) pushes jointness to tactical level (DoD 2024). DoD also notes operational regulations last updated in 1999, so integration is still maturing.
weightNotes.initiative: DoD 2024 cites the 'Five Incapables' slogan: officers who cannot judge situations, understand intent, make decisions, deploy troops or handle the unexpected. Party committee command and centralised C2 keep this low.
weightNotes.logisticsDiscipline: Joint Logistic Support Force and civil mobilisation (ro-ro ferries) are planned, but DoD 2024 states long-distance logistics at the scale of a Taiwan campaign is undemonstrated; operations would likely stay tied to the coast and strike range.

summary: A large, rapidly modernised force whose doctrine treats war as a confrontation between operational systems. It plans to open with massed precision strikes by the Rocket Force, air force and navy against command, ISR, air bases and logistics (systems destruction warfare, now Multi-Domain Precision Warfare), contest space and the electromagnetic spectrum, and keep US forces outside the first island chain with layered anti-access/area-denial (missiles, submarines, aviation). Ground and amphibious forces then exploit the paralysis. Command is centralised through theatre joint commands under the Central Military Commission.
whyItWorked: Not tested in combat. On paper the A2/AD complex is strong: CSIS's 24-run Taiwan wargame cost the US and its allies dozens of ships, hundreds of aircraft and tens of thousands of servicemembers. The PLA has the world's largest navy, a deep precision-missile inventory and industrial capacity to replace losses.
whereItFailed: Last real test, Vietnam 1979, exposed poor logistics, communications and combined arms and heavy casualties for limited gains (Zhang 2015). In CSIS's 2023 wargames a conventional amphibious invasion of Taiwan was defeated in most of the 24 runs, with China also losing heavily. DoD 2024 flags command initiative and urban/long-distance logistics as unproven, and senior purges may have disrupted readiness.
